core-fifteen.title: The Core 15: a first year of learning
core-fifteen.summary: Why these fifteen courses were chosen for disability services work, and how Start here, Apply it and Lead it build on each other across a year.

decision-depth.title: Analyzing a decision at the right depth
decision-depth.summary: Learn to match an equity analysis to the stakes of a decision, from a ten-minute quick check to an in-depth review, and recognize when a quick check is not enough.

how-program-works.title: How the program works
how-program-works.summary: You will see how five connected areas, three pillars of equity practice and six core commitments fit together, so you can start from the work already in front of you.

program-charter.title: The Program charter in five minutes
program-charter.summary: You will learn what the Program charter commits this program to, where its limits sit, and how those limits protect your decisions, your privacy and the people you serve.

welcome-to-one-dsd.title: Welcome to One DSD
welcome-to-one-dsd.summary: A guided walk through the site as it is today: the five main sections, the Start page, Ask, and your private My work space and learning journey.

community-briefs.title: Using a community brief without profiling anyone
community-briefs.summary: Learn how to read a Minnesota Communities brief as context for better questions and access planning, never as a description of the person in front of you.

draft-review.title: Reviewing a draft for equity, access and plain language
draft-review.summary: See how to review a notice or form before it goes out, using two guided practices and the plain language checklist to find barriers and support the owner.

equity-pause.title: An Equity Pause in ten minutes
equity-pause.summary: Follow one routine scheduling decision through the Equity Pause, from naming who it affects to choosing an alternative, setting a next step, and knowing when to go deeper.

learning-journey.title: Your learning journey and the four levels
learning-journey.summary: How to use the Your learning journey panel on My work, what the four levels mean, and why your journey is entirely your own.

right-person.title: When a decision belongs to a person
right-person.summary: How Find the right person points you to the people and offices who hold a decision, and which matters belong with other teams from the very start.
